title: Can two input bits transmit a bond to every depth in sample 0, line 4710?
claim: In sample 0, line 4710, every positive first-child depth admits a bond to a fresh own distinction. A construction on pairs of bits gives size at most floor(s/2)+3, and a fixed top b can be used with at most ceil(s/2)+3. A second construction gives ceil(s/4)+3 at every s>=2. Together with the unrestricted lower bound 1+ceil(s/6) this proves linear growth. The exact unrestricted minima at depths 1 through 8 are 3,4,4,4,5,5,5,5.
failure_conditions: A projected witness cannot be extended, a hidden spectator changes the claimed transition, or the stated support retains a constraint after one erasure.

validation.status: Symbolic backwards completion of an arbitrary chain; separate scalar rederivation and raw SAT for the exact four-level table through depth 32; all erasures and canonical knotlab controls. The full-tree fixed-budget computation excludes 3 from depth 2 and 4 from depth 5. Independent same-task readers checked the source, both parities, root choice and off-branch extension.
validation.field_novelty: unassessed; no claim of a new general automaton, NAE identity or general CSP theorem.

foundation_claim_scope: Finite supports in the allowed states of the specified branching system. Infinite finite-flip sources and frequencies are separate questions.
standard_statement: Under existential completion of the full three-port branching relation in sample 0 line 4710, a finite minimally constrained support meeting the root and a fresh variable at every positive first-child depth exists with size linear in depth.
prior_work: The one-input test at two levels excluded uniform links; the accepted arbitrary-support bound is 1+ceil(s/6). The fixed-size decision procedure applies independently to specific size budgets.
completion_gate: Exact local transcription, existential extension on both parities, proof of every deletion, uniform four-level finite-table argument, independent finite checks and small-budget unrestricted exclusions.
open_questions: Exact unrestricted minimum at general depth and its sharp asymptotic coefficient.
Existence at all positive depths in the remaining 153 conditional records.
